title: Unknown Home
description: App grid, favorites, inputs and optional physical Home-button routing. Installs a separate Home application; Core remains the independent recovery manager.
disableDescription: Removes this module's Home-button routing and closes Unknown Home if it is in the foreground. The installed Home app and its preferences remain. Home-button routing is saved as OFF and must be explicitly enabled again later.
publisher: Unknown Digital and Unknown Suite contributors
permissions: Installs the bundled org.unknown.home.module application and elevates its launcher service using the existing Homebrew helper
Optional volatile surface-manager Home-key filter; no firmware or Developer Mode marker changes
Reads installed apps and inputs; owner actions can launch or uninstall apps and save favorites

status.title: Check Home module
status.description: Shows whether the Home app is installed, routing is saved as ON and the key filter is present. The physical remote still needs an owner test; this check does not press Home.

health.title: Check Home health
health.description: Checks the installed Home app and any requested Home-key filter. It does not prove that every remote or TV model delivers the physical key correctly.

openHome.title: Open Unknown Home
openHome.description: Launches your installed Unknown Home screen now. It does not change which screen the remote Home button opens.

setHomeButton.title: Home button override
setHomeButton.description: Changes the supported remote Home-key route without replacing LG firmware. The LG Home command inside Unknown Home remains available as a fallback.

enabled.title: Home-button routing
enabled.description: ON routes the physical Home button to Unknown Home. OFF removes this module's route so the TV's normal Home behavior resumes.
